title: The Loop Computer in Minecraft (Loop 1.0 / Loop 2.1)
format: raw PNG screenshots (archival originals); web-optimized derivatives are a builder step, not stored here
note: Minecraft is Mojang/Microsoft IP; these are the operator's own screenshots of his own build. Attribution/usage to be confirmed at ship (operator).

dating_reconciliation.computer_first_component: 2017-05 (the clock — in-game sign 'Clock constructed by Shea May 2017', image 18)

images.shows: The machine's explanatory placard: two 4-bit values -> loop-line memory -> one of two registers (RegA=Diamond, RegB=Gold) -> add or NAND -> answer back to loop. Carries the completion sign (Jul 7 2024), the Jan 2026 additions, and the Jul 29 2026 Loop-MMT-origin note.
Wide overhead of the whole build against the world map, gold register blocks centered, the long descending corridor.
The loop-indicator light row on a wall with a Loop Indicator Light On/Off sign; beacon beams in the corner.
Tiered redstone internals with bus lines and the color-coded logic section.
Floor-level numbered bus lines (bits) with repeaters/torches and a redstone lamp.
A long corridor in the world build with Enable Scary Face / Light switch for throne room signs.
Control floor with numbered bus lines and Register select A/B + Enable Registry Load signs.
The 4-bit input lever bank (B1-B4) under a fence rail, with redstone lamps and the snowy landscape below.
Deep interior: pistons, observers, mossy blocks, bus lines.
Rainbow beacon beams overhead and an indicator-light matrix on the wall.
The whole machine sprawling in a snowy biome inside its containment walls.
Top-down of the computational core: colored wool registers and tangled red bus lines.
The adder area with a sign: ADDER A+B, 4-BIT INPUTS, 5-BIT OUTPUT.
The color-coded logic array (orange/blue/yellow wool = gate stages) with numbered buses; a glass structure lower-left.
First-person POV down the throne-room corridor with hotbar; moon in the sky.
A dense vertical wiring plane: colored blocks and numbered redstone lines.
Control-panel close-up: ON preserves value to loop / OFF destructively clears; Output reset register back to loop line memory; Load register enable; RegA=Diamond RegB=Gold.
The origin sign: 'Clock constructed by Shea May 2017', beside Trapdoor and 'Speakers: Loop Memory or Entrance Door' signs, over the world map. The dated birth of the first component.
Clock/counter detail: Clocked signal Load / Counter Pulse +1 signs.
The long loop-line memory corridor of repeaters receding to a vanishing point — the mercury-delay-line analog, alive only in motion.
